messages:
alex: Heads up — after the 09:00 deploy I'm seeing short-burst p95 spike on host-side for streaming gRPC. Symptoms: lots of tiny write syscalls, increased CPU in the path before the runtime. stack: ingress -> preparse -> tokenizer -> runtime. Anyone seen this pattern?

priya: started a quick flame. Early look: top hotspots are `writev` and `hpack_encode` in the proxy, then preparse tokenization. PCAP shows many ~128B frames instead of coalesced chunks.

dan: can you paste the flame summary and current streaming config? curious about `max_frame_size` / `batch_hint` / `SO_SNDBUF`.

alex: flame (top lines):
```
writev 36%
hpack_encode 22%
preparse::tokenize 15%
memcpy 10%
grpc_stream_chunk 6%
other 11%
```
Also seeing lots of `accept`/`recv` syscalls per request in the trace. This is concentrated on <=16 token responses (minibursts).

erika: likely two orthogonal issues: small-writes + HPACK work on headers, and preparse doing per-request re-tokenize because KV cache misses on short-prefixes. Quick wins: enable socket coalescing on the proxy, bump `SO_SNDBUF`, and increase streaming chunk size to reduce syscall count. For KV side, check prefix-key normalization so minibursts hit cache.

priya: did a quick canary: toggled `SO_SNDBUF` from 4k -> 64k on one proxy instance and enabled `TCP_CORK`-like coalesce. Result: syscalls down ~70% for the traced flows, host CPU p95 dropped ~30%. Memory usage up marginally under high concurrency though.

dan: good. I'll add a light instrumentation to trace KV cache hits for the miniburst keyspace (sampled) — want to confirm whether repeated tiny requests are causing eviction churn. Also will instrument `batch_hint` path to see if microbatching is being bypassed for these flows.

perf-bot: Perf test 1769005555-rc2: short-response p95 +18% vs baseline on default ingress. Test details: 5000 requests, response tokens <=16, concurrency=50.

alex:Thanks. Proposed action items:
- priya: roll the SO_SNDBUF + coalesce canary to 10% more hosts and monitor mem tail (ETA 2h)
- dan: add sampled KV hittrace + batch_hint telemetry (ETA EOD)
- erika: PR for ingress to default chunk_size=4k for streaming short responses (small perf opt) (ETA tomorrow)
- perf-bot / infra: run microbench with coalesce enabled (compare writev counts)

Anyone object to moving forward with the canary expansion? :eyes:

erika: :+1: no objections from me. we should also gate by memory per-tenant so we don't blow up at scale.

alex: ok will expand to 10% and post results here. thanks all.
